feat: add multi-tenant management system

## New Features

### Management API \(packages/management-api/\)
- Bun + Elysia REST API with Swagger documentation
- Bearer token authentication \(Master Token\)
- Full CRUD operations for projects
- Automatic JWT key generation per project
- Database, S3, and Nginx route provisioning

### API Endpoints
- GET/POST /v1/projects - List/Create projects
- GET/DELETE /v1/projects/:ref - Get/Delete project
- GET/PUT /v1/projects/:ref/settings - Project config
- GET /v1/projects/:ref/status - Health status
- POST /v1/projects/:ref/restart - Restart services
- GET /v1/projects/:ref/api-keys - Get API keys

### Shell Scripts \(scripts/lib/\)
- db_manager.sh - PostgreSQL database/role management
- s3_manager.sh - S3 bucket management
- router_manager.sh - Nginx dynamic routing
- jwt_manager.sh - JWT key generation

### CLI Tool \(supacloud\)
- supacloud list/create/info/delete/keys/health

### CI/CD
- GitHub Actions workflow for API linting and testing
- Bun test with JWT service unit tests

### Documentation
- docs/multi-tenant-management.md - Technical specification
